name: Castora Agri Commodities Limited
about: Castora Agri Commodities Limited engages in manufacturing, import, marketing, trading, distribution, export, consultancy, and allied services relating to agricultural, farm, forest, food, timber, and allied products in India. The company offers products, such as castor oil, castor seeds, corn, kabuli chana, chana dal, and wheat; end-to-end supply chain management solutions that integrate procurement, warehousing, transportation, inventory planning, and logistics coordination; and quality assurance, global trade strategy, commodity products, bulk supply capacity, and strategy and market expansion solutions. It serves farmers, suppliers, processors, and logistics partners to source commodities. The company was formerly known as Gopal Iron & Steel Co. (Gujarat) Limited and changed its name to Castora Agri Commodities Limited in April 2026. Castora Agri Commodities Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Harij, India.
